$comment: One entry of the `skills` value: a skill pinned to an immutable source. Referenced from values.yaml (`skills: [] # @schema itemRef:skill.schema.json`) and bundled into values.schema.json by the helm-schema pre-commit hook. It mirrors what the kagent.dev/v1alpha3 AgentTemplate CRD refuses at admission (spec.skills[].source), so a branch, a tag, a short SHA or an OCI tag fails `helm template` instead of the API server.

name.description: Name of the skill, unique within the agent.

git.description: A git repository at a full commit id; exactly one of git and oci is set.

commit.description: Full commit id, 40 or 64 hex characters. Branches, tags and short SHAs are refused.

oci.description: Digest-pinned image reference (`<ref>@sha256:<64 hex>`); a tag is refused. Exactly one of git and oci is set.

path.description: Directory of the skill within the artifact: relative, no `..` segments.
